007package com.oracle.database.selectai.samples.agent;
008
009import com.oracle.database.selectai.agent.SelectAIAgent;
010import com.oracle.database.selectai.agent.Team;
011import com.oracle.database.selectai.model.agent.TeamAttributes;
012import com.oracle.database.selectai.model.agent.TeamAttributes.TeamMember;
013import com.oracle.database.selectai.model.agent.TeamStatus;
014import com.oracle.database.selectai.model.DbConnectionConfig;
015import com.oracle.database.selectai.model.SelectAIException;
016
017import java.util.Arrays;
018import java.util.List;
019
020/**
021 * Sample for creating a {@code DBMS_CLOUD_AI_AGENT} team.
022 *
023 * <p>Required environment variables are {@code SELECTAI_DB_USER},
024 * {@code SELECTAI_DB_PASSWORD}, {@code SELECTAI_JDBC_URL},
025 * {@code SELECTAI_AGENT_TEAM_NAME}, {@code SELECTAI_AGENT_TEAM_AGENTS}, and
026 * {@code SELECTAI_AGENT_TEAM_PROCESS}. The agents variable is a comma-separated
027 * list of {@code agentName:taskName} pairs, for example
028 * {@code SUPPORT_AGENT:SUPPORT_TASK,BILLING_AGENT:BILLING_TASK}.</p>
029 *
030 * <p>{@code SELECTAI_AGENT_TEAM_LONG_TERM_MEMORY_LENGTH},
031 * {@code SELECTAI_AGENT_TEAM_SUPERVISOR_AGENT},
032 * {@code SELECTAI_AGENT_TEAM_DESCRIPTION}, and
033 * {@code SELECTAI_AGENT_TEAM_STATUS} are optional. The database default for
034 * long-term memory length is 30.</p>
035 */
036public final class CreateTeamSample {
037
038    private CreateTeamSample() {
039    }
040
041    /**
042     * Runs the sample and propagates failures to the command-line caller.
043     *
044     * @param args command-line arguments; not used
045     * @throws SelectAIException when an SDK operation fails
046     */
047    public static void main(String[] args) throws SelectAIException {
048        String teamName = requiredEnv("SELECTAI_AGENT_TEAM_NAME");
049        try (SelectAIAgent selectAIAgent = createSelectAIAgent()) {
050            TeamAttributes attributes = TeamAttributes.builder()
051                    .agents(parseAgents(requiredEnv("SELECTAI_AGENT_TEAM_AGENTS")))
052                    .process(requiredEnv("SELECTAI_AGENT_TEAM_PROCESS"))
053                    .longTermMemoryLength(
054                            optionalInteger("SELECTAI_AGENT_TEAM_LONG_TERM_MEMORY_LENGTH"))
055                    .supervisorAgent(env("SELECTAI_AGENT_TEAM_SUPERVISOR_AGENT"))
056                    .build();
057            Team team = selectAIAgent.team(teamName, attributes,
058                    env("SELECTAI_AGENT_TEAM_DESCRIPTION"), status("SELECTAI_AGENT_TEAM_STATUS"));
059
060            boolean created = team.create();
061            System.out.printf("Create team '%s' completed: %s%n", team.getTeamName(), created);
062        }
063    }
064
065    private static SelectAIAgent createSelectAIAgent() throws SelectAIException {
066        return SelectAIAgent.create(DbConnectionConfig.builder()
067                .dbUser(requiredEnv("SELECTAI_DB_USER"))
068                .dbPassword(requiredEnv("SELECTAI_DB_PASSWORD"))
069                .jdbcUrl(requiredEnv("SELECTAI_JDBC_URL"))
070                .build());
071    }
072
073    private static String requiredEnv(String name) {
074        String value = System.getenv(name);
075        if (value == null || value.isBlank()) {
076            throw new IllegalStateException("Missing required environment variable: " + name);
077        }
078        return value;
079    }
080
081    private static String env(String name) {
082        String value = System.getenv(name);
083        return value == null || value.isBlank() ? null : value;
084    }
085
086    private static List<TeamMember> parseAgents(String value) {
087        List<TeamMember> agents = Arrays.stream(value.split(","))
088                .map(String::trim)
089                .filter(item -> !item.isEmpty())
090                .map(CreateTeamSample::parseAgent)
091                .toList();
092        if (agents.isEmpty()) {
093            throw new IllegalStateException(
094                    "SELECTAI_AGENT_TEAM_AGENTS must contain at least one agent:task pair");
095        }
096        return agents;
097    }
098
099    private static TeamMember parseAgent(String value) {
100        String[] parts = value.split(":", 2);
101        if (parts.length != 2 || parts[0].isBlank() || parts[1].isBlank()) {
102            throw new IllegalStateException(
103                    "Each SELECTAI_AGENT_TEAM_AGENTS entry must use agentName:taskName format");
104        }
105        return TeamMember.builder(parts[0].trim()).task(parts[1].trim()).build();
106    }
107
108    private static Integer optionalInteger(String name) {
109        String value = env(name);
110        return value == null ? null : Integer.valueOf(value);
111    }
112
113    private static TeamStatus status(String name) {
114        String value = env(name);
115        return value == null ? null : TeamStatus.fromValue(value);
116    }
117}
